purpose: Acceptance samples only: file positions, hashes and facts a person must check. Never read by the production worker.

check_kinds.native_code: Program-copied code: characters and indentation must be exactly right. Only 'correct' passes.
check_kinds.visual_fact: Information carried by the picture: must be saved correctly or sent to review. 'correct' or 'reviewed' passes.
check_kinds.text: Native text must be kept. Only 'correct' passes.
check_kinds.review_quality: Reviews must be precise; count unnecessary reviews separately.

checks.fact: Table with 3 columns (Type de séance, Nombre, Durée): CM 3 1h30; TD 4 1h30; TP 3 4h. Rows must not be mixed up.
Total : 22h30.
Order CM1 → TD1 → CM2 → TD2 → TP1 → CM3 → TD3 → TP2 → TD4 → TP3.
The top navigation bar and page number need no review.
(−1)^S: S is an exponent, not a factor.
The mantissa is written 1.M (a point). The text layer shows 1:M; that must not be presented as the formula.
2^(E−biais): E−biais is the exponent, not 2E−biais.
Single precision: S 1 bit, Exposant (E) 8 bits, Mantisse (M) 23 bits, in this order.
biais = 127; bit implicite = 1.
The malloc / if (tab == NULL) / for / free(tab) code keeps its characters and indentation; return 1; is one line.
The string keeps the visible-space symbols: "plus␣de␣memoire\n".
The three bullets on the right are not woven into the code lines.
Box 'Ce que vous verrez dans beaucoup de code' and its text are kept.
The realloc correction keeps its characters and nesting; int nouvelle = capacite * 2; is one line; arr[taille] = valeur; and taille++ follow the if block.
Two UML classes, Livre and Rapport, each with attributes and methods as printed.
Members printed in dark red are the ones both classes share: titre, auteur, afficher(), toString().
The problem statement about describing identical properties twice is kept.
Manager and Programmer inherit from Employee (triangle points to the parent).
Project Manager, Dept. Manager and Strategic Manager inherit from Manager, not from Employee directly.
Attributes stay with their class: Manager budgetsControlled, dateAppointed; Programmer project, progLanguages; Project Manager projects; Dept. Manager dept; Strategic Manager responsibilities.
The sentence about the inheritance graph is kept.
A x; A a1 = new A(...); B b1 = new B(...); C c1 = new C(...); x = a1; → OK; x = b1; → OK; x = c1 → OK (no semicolon after c1 in the source).
Public class A{ …} / Public class B extends A{ …} / Public class C extends B{ ...} stay separate from the left column.
C hérite de B, qui hérite de A; the definition of type dynamique is kept.
d1.afficher(); → afficher() de Document, then d1 = r1;, then d1.afficher(); → afficher() de Rapport, in this order.
Ce mécanisme s'appelle la liaison dynamique ("late binding").
